digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: भारत के बंदरगाह के पास होर्मुज में एक भारतीय जहाज पर दो टारपीडो दागे, जिससे एक नाविक की मौत हुई और 19 अन्य सुरक्षित रहे। इस घटना के बाद ओमान के पास एक अलग भारतीय जहाज पर भी हमला हुआ, जिसमें एक और नाविक की मृत्यु हुई।

articles.title: Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction
articles.summary: At a meeting of the group’s board in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, the governors unveiled a 66-project blueprint to get things started while acknowledging enormous hurdles that must still be overcome Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction.

articles.title: Iranian advisers helped Houthis seize Yemen's Red Sea coast in less than 48 hours: report
articles.summary: The key port city of Mokha was abandoned as residents left in the night, allowing the Houthis to roll in unopposed on September 10. Their seizure of strategic islands nearby further enhanced their ability to attack Saudi oil shipments in the Red Sea Iranian advisers helped Houthis seize Yemen's Red Sea coast in less than 48 hours: report.

articles.title: We have been victims of terrorism: Iran President tells UN in rare wartime address
articles.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian held up photos of the late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and the more than 150 school children killed on the first days of the war; The ‌United States delegation walked out ‌at ⁠the start of the speech Tehran will not surrender in war with U. S., but believes in diplomacy: Iran President tells UN. We have been victims of terrorism: Iran President tells UN in rare wartime address.

articles.title: Soorya Krishnamoorthy, who dedicated his life to promote arts, passes away in Keralam
articles.summary: The Soorya Stage and Film Society founded by him has been bringing the best of musicians, dancers and films to Thiruvananthapuram in Keralam every year without fail as part of the Soorya Music, Dance and Film Festival Soorya Krishnamoorthy, who dedicated his life to promote arts, passes away in Keralam.

articles.title: Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran
articles.summary: An Afghan migrant reported that his stepmother and four sisters died An Afghan migrant has told RFE/RL's Radio Azadi that his stepmother and four sisters died of thirst and hunger while attempting a dangerous journey to Iran after economic hardship forced the family to leave Afghanistan again. Five Afghan Family Members Die Of Thirst While Trying To Reach Iran.

articles.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
articles.summary: Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessorVenezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro. Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby.

articles.title: World leaders debate ongoing war in Ukraine
articles.summary: Five years of war. Another winter closing in. Today, the Security Council once again debates a path to peace – though any resolution still runs up against the veto of Russia, one of its own permanent members, whose objections have repeatedly stalled any consensus. As world leaders take the floor, the gap between diplomatic process and battlefield reality appears to be stark.

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
articles.summary: More than 130 days into the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), health experts said on Wednesday that response efforts have been scaled up significantly and “the first encouraging signs of progress” are now being seen. DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths.

articles.title: US Set To Unveil Next Steps for Trump-Backed Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Corridor
articles.summary: The United States is set to unveil the next stage of TRIPP, a planned transport corridor through southern Armenia that Washington says could open new trade routes linking the South Caucasus and Central Asia with Western markets. US Set To Unveil Next Steps for Trump-Backed Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Corridor.

articles.title: ‘Super El Niño’ projected to cause 15,800 additional heat deaths in India, says report
articles.summary: The heaviest toll is expected in poorer countries, already struggling with food insecurity and high energy costs, partly due to climate change and the fallout of the war in Iran, the University of Chicago-based Climate Impact Lab says This year’s El Niño-driven heat could cause nearly half a million more deaths, group says. ‘This year’s El Niño is also a ‘postcard from our future’, bringing temperatures climate change is projected to deliver 20 years in the future.

articles.title: Indian billionaire’s payments firm plots biggest London flotation in years
articles.summary: Sunil Bharti Mittal’s Airtel Money targets $9bn IPO in boost for ailing UK stock marketNils Pratley: Does this mark the end of London’s listing drought? Not yetA payments business that operates across Africa and is ultimately controlled by an Indian billionaire has announced its intention to float on the struggling London Stock Exchange.

articles.title: Iranian Hard-Liners Up In Arms After Araqchi-Witkoff Meeting In New York
articles.summary: Iranian hard‑liners condemned the meeting between US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in New York on US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi met in New York on September 22 following days of signals that US-Iranian talks would take place on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The meeting sparked a backlash from Iranian hard-liners.

articles.title: Amid Setbacks In The Sahel, Russia Quietly And Quickly Builds Ties In Madagascar
articles.summary: Russia’s efforts to cultivate clout in Africa’s Sahel have been a mixed bag of successes and setbacks. Across the continent, however, on the Indian Ocean island of Madagascar, Moscow is making another quiet push for influence. Amid Setbacks In The Sahel, Russia Quietly And Quickly Builds Ties In Madagascar.

articles.title: Why China’s Silicon Valley won’t need American degrees
articles.summary: For nearly a century, American global power has rested on a three-legged tripod: unmatched military firepower, the ubiquitous sovereignty of the US dollar and the intellectual dominance of its higher-education system. While aircraft carriers project hard power and Wall Street manages global capital, the American university system has quietly manufactured the “soft power,” technological breakthroug Why China’s Silicon Valley won’t need American degrees.

articles.title: Time to recognize the Houthis as Yemen’s real government
articles.summary: The Trump administration came perilously close to launching another bombing campaign against Yemen this weekend. According to a September 20 New York Times report, US commanders had approved their targets, American troops were loading bombs onto warplanes, and an attack on Yemen’s Ansar Allah forces was about to begin when President Donald Trump abruptly reversed course. articles.title: Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big
articles.summary: The move comes after Jamaica’s culture minister Olivia Grange travelled to the UK earlier this month to lodge the historic petitionKing Charles has referred a landmark slavery reparations petition from Jamaica to a high-level UK appeals court for legal advice, Jamaica’s culture minister announced in parliament on Tuesday. Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big.

articles.title: Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Trump said he believes that both sides "want to see the war end." Zelenskyy said Ukraine is pushing for an agreement with Russia on halting attacks on energy infrastructure. Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire.

articles.title: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him
articles.summary: US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member stateDonald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of former Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state. Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him.

articles.title: Why Saudi Arabia’s Oil Is Getting Harder To Ship
articles.summary: The crises in the Middle East are creating a growing challenge for Saudi Arabia: how it gets its oil to global markets. Shipping costs are rising, oil has topped $105 a barrel, and global inventories are being rapidly drained. Why Saudi Arabia’s Oil Is Getting Harder To Ship.

articles.title: Children demand a voice on AI’s future
articles.summary: The first generation to grow up with AI may also be the last one anyone thinks to ask about it – and that has to change, the UN's top human rights official said on Tuesday. Children demand a voice on AI’s future.

articles.title: UN rendered unable to fulfil its mission, Turkish President laments before world leaders
articles.summary: The United Nations continues to be weakened, and those who have tied their hopes to the world body – from Palestine to Sudan – have been disappointed, Türkiye’s President said, while adding that his country is committed to restoring confidence in the Organization. UN rendered unable to fulfil its mission, Turkish President laments before world leaders.

articles.title: Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump used his address to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday to defend recent military action against Iran, urging countries to maintain economic pressure on Tehran – and declaring that he now faces a choice between making a deal, or taking far more drastic steps. Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI.

articles.title: Cambodia’s anti-scam summit can’t whitewash its own record
articles.summary: This week, Cambodia welcomes foreign diplomats, law-enforcement officials and financial regulators to Phnom Penh for the “International Conference on Combating Online Scams.” Prime Minister Hun Manet’s administration is presenting the gathering as proof that it is ready to confront a criminal trade that has ruined lives across the globe. Yet the official messaging also reveals [] The post Cambodi Cambodia’s anti-scam summit can’t whitewash its own record.

articles.title: At least four people killed in Japan as typhoon Dujuan triggers heavy rain, landslides
articles.summary: Rescuers search for missing in collapsed homes after storm causes landslides, travel chaos and power outagesTyphoon Dujuan has killed at least four people and injured 22 in Japan, while tens of thousands of houses near Tokyo remained without power after the storm swept through the region, authorities said on Tuesday. At least four people killed in Japan as typhoon Dujuan triggers heavy rain, landslides.

articles.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting
articles.summary: Canadian province alleges deadly attack could have been prevented if company had warned police of shooter’s ChatGPT useBritish Columbia has sued OpenAI in California, saying a mass shooting at a school in the province could have been prevented if the company had warned local ⁠law enforcement that the shooter ⁠had used ChatGPT to ​plan the massacre. British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting.

articles.summary: ईरान के राष्ट्रपति मसूद पेजेश्कियान ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा के संबोधन में अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप के बयान पर प्रतिक्रिया दी है. उन्होंने कहा, अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ने हमें आतंकवादी कहा है. जबकि, हम खुद आतंकवाद से ग्रस्त रहे हैं. ईरानी राष्ट्रपति ने उन स्कूल के बच्चों का जिक्र किया, जो अमेरिका और इजरायल के हमले में मारे गए थे. तेहरान के राष्ट्रपति ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा 81वें सेशन को संबोधित करत।

articles.summary: बलोचिस्तान लिबरेशन फ्रंट (BLF) ने महिलाओं की नई सशस्त्र यूनिट करीमा आर्म्ड असॉल्ट डिवीजन (KAAD) के गठन का ऐलान किया है. BLF का दावा है कि KAAD ने तुरबत के जोस्क इलाके में CPEC हाईवे के पास पाकिस्तानी सेना के काफिले पर अपनी पहली कार्रवाई की. बलोचिस्तान की ‘शेरनियां’ अब मैदान-ए-जंग में, BLF ने बनाई नई फाइटिंग यूनिट KAAD: करीमा आर्म्ड असॉल्ट।
